summary: 3D physics oil-wrestling game inspired by Kırkpınar, v2 with a versus card, visible oil and a three-year golden belt, built by Claude Sonnet 5.5 · Kırkpınar'dan esinlenen 3D fizikli yağlı güreş, v2'de rakip kartı, görünen yağ ve üç yıllık altın kemer, Claude Sonnet 5.5 yaptı
key_features: Oiled grips slip: grip strength decays with hold time, oil and sweat, effort and stamina; v2 shows the oil as skin gloss, droplets, grass stains and a grip-bar tick
Readable balance: a centre-of-mass lean over the feet decides steps and falls onto the back, side or front
Classic finishing moves as context moves: paça kazık, çaprast, künde, lift and carry, yere çal and a leg hook

v2: one-click Play with a 2.5 s versus card and a first-bout coach, bouts of 60-120 s that grow with the class, a three-year golden belt and cazgır facts; five weight classes, quick match and 2 players
The AI uses the same inputs as a player; the ?auto bot played a career to the golden belt (v2: 23 bouts, 18 wins)

social.headline: Grip, pull and throw on the oiled grass until your rival's back touches the ground · Yağlı çimende tut, çek, at: rakibin sırtını yere getir
